title_en: Into My Arms: Structured reinforcement learning for autonomous transport of objects and humans
title_zh: Into My Arms：用于自主搬运物体和人类的结构化强化学习
summary_en: The paper addresses the trilemma of high-dimensional state-action spaces, contact-rich environments, and long task horizons in whole-body humanoid manipulation with three structured RL contributions: Sparse Interaction Edges (SIE) for whole-body manipulation, Interaction Gated Transport (IGT) for sustained transport over long horizons, and a Hinted Object Path (HOP) to resolve collision and search complexity bottlenecks. The policy remains free to discover its own manipulation strategy. The method generalizes from rigid object to human transport, demonstrating the first bed-to-wheelchair transfer of a medical mannequin by a humanoid robot with no human intervention during execution. For human transfer, a single policy adapts across variations in body mass, size, and random force perturbations, training on a single GPU in under an hour.
summary_zh: 本文针对全身人形机器人操作中高维状态-动作空间、富接触环境和长任务视野的三难问题，提出三种结构化强化学习（RL）贡献：用于全身操作的稀疏交互边（SIE）、用于长视野持续运输的交互门控运输（IGT），以及解决碰撞和搜索复杂度瓶颈的提示物体路径（HOP）。策略仍可自由发现自身的操作策略。该方法从刚性物体泛化到人体运输，首次展示了人形机器人在执行过程中无人工干预的情况下完成医疗假人的床到轮椅转移。在人体转移方面，单一策略可适应体重、体型和随机力扰动的显著变化，且在单块GPU上训练不到一小时。
content_en: Whole-body humanoid manipulation remains bottlenecked by high-dimensional state-action spaces, contact-rich environments, and long task horizons. This trilemma is a challenge that state-of-the-art reinforcement learning (RL) methods are yet to resolve reliably. We address it with three contributions that add just enough structure to guide exploration: Sparse Interaction Edges (SIE) for whole-body manipulation, Interaction Gated Transport (IGT) for sustained transport over long horizons, and a Hinted Object Path (HOP) that resolves collision and search complexity bottlenecks. Across all three, the policy remains free to discover its own manipulation strategy. The method generalises from rigid object to human transport. As a flagship demonstration, we show, to our knowledge, the first bed-to-wheelchair transfer of a medical mannequin by a humanoid robot completed with no human intervention during execution. In the domain of human transfer, we show that a single policy can adapt across substantial variations in body mass, size, and random force perturbations, all while training on a single GPU in under an hour. Our approach offers a pathway to fully RL-driven humanoid manipulation, enabling assistive robots that can help humans. Website: https://elle-miller.github.io/into_my_arms
content_zh: 全身人形操作仍然受限于高维状态-动作空间、富接触环境以及长任务时域。这一三难困境是当前最先进的强化学习（RL）方法尚未可靠解决的挑战。我们通过三项贡献来应对这一问题，这些贡献仅添加了恰到好处的结构来引导探索：用于全身操作的稀疏交互边（Sparse Interaction Edges, SIE）、用于长时域持续运输的交互门控运输（Interaction Gated Transport, IGT），以及解决碰撞与搜索复杂度瓶颈的提示物体路径（Hinted Object Path, HOP）。在这三项贡献中，策略始终保持自由，以发现自身的操作策略。该方法从刚性物体泛化到人体运输。作为一项旗舰演示，我们展示了据我们所知首次由人形机器人在执行过程中无需任何人工干预完成的医疗假人从床到轮椅的转移。在人体转移领域，我们表明单一策略能够适应体重、体型和随机力扰动的大幅变化，且仅需在单块 GPU 上训练不到一小时。我们的方法为完全由 RL 驱动的人形操作提供了一条路径，使辅助机器人能够帮助人类。网站：https://elle-miller.github.io/into_my_arms
